answer: Unique-work cipher commitment. Each agent must submit a distinct, verifiable proof-of-work whose solution seeds a per-agent cipher key, and the registry only admits keys whose commitments differ from every active key by a fixed minimum distance. A rotating public beacon publishes the challenge epoch, so an attacker cannot precompute solutions or reuse one across clones. Cloning now costs a fresh search per identity plus forfeiture of a salted ivory deposit released only after sustained honest use.
